fieldFixes.summary: Establishes a set of ontologies (concepts, definitions, axioms and use cases) to support ethically driven methodologies for designing robots and automation systems, usable as a guideline or as a reference taxonomy shared across disciplines.

fieldFixes.note: addressedTo is a borderline 'system': the standard is a reference vocabulary (a set of ontologies, described in the abstract as usable 'as a guideline or as a reference "taxonomy"'), not a process an organisation runs and not a list of design requirements; its declared object is the design of robots and automation systems, which is the closest fit. 'Ontological' in the title describes the content; the document type is a Standard (IEEE SA: 'Active Standard'). The abstract is cut off on the Xplore page ('Users of t...') but complete on the IEEE SA page, where the remainder concerns formal logic (Common Logic Interchange Format) and a link; the purpose is cut off on the Xplore page ('The use of ontologies for representing ...') and its remainder was not seen.
